positions.name: MissingIdTestSpec
positions.frame: what must the derive-id test case reproduce and guarantee to validate the missing-id fix?
positions.why: src-1 names the diagnostic target the test is built to reproduce (the prod missing-id failure pattern, framed flatly as settled fact — past, realis, concrete per the temporal read) while src-2 states the acceptance criteria that target must satisfy (must not crash; must produce a valid slug — future-directed, irrealis, delivered as a bare directive per the temporal and relational reads). Read together, both expressions cohere around one question: what does this specific test case need to reproduce and enforce. The tension between describing a known failure and prescribing a required outcome is the frame itself, not something to resolve.
